title: Super Bowl Ads
eligible_reason: Effect of Super Bowl ad exposure on sales using continuous DMA-level game ratings (rtg, rtg x brand-advertised) with brand-DMA FE and year FE; continuous treatment, not a staggered binary adoption.
design_notes: ReplicationFilesForProprietaryDataInPaper/BeerRegs.do and SodaRegs.do: xtreg v72HH rtg rtg_ad [PostGRPs NFLgrps price feature display] i.beeryear, fe i(branddma) cluster(dma) (Tables 2, 4-8); weekly-by-week regressions for Figures 3-4. CRLF do-files explain the empty regression inventory.
data_files_note: ReadMeFirst: Nielsen AdViews GRP data proprietary; public folder ships only top-56-market ratings and requires Kilts Nielsen scanner data to rebuild sales; SimulationCode folder is empty in the extracted package.
data_provenance_note: Sales (Nielsen scanner) and GRP data not shipped; only ratings inputs.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract from data/frame/mksc.jsonl read. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
